liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Garcia dives deep into this Dylan song, bringing up rare treasure [26]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Phil's bombs in this song make the recording worth having [23]
- **High Time** (1 review): Jerry plays a rare solo of seven shockingly brilliant notes [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-01.cpb.retransfer.32709.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1985-11-01.177938.Senn.MD421.strizak.flac2448**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 155 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd85-11-01.sbd.mccloskey.379.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 154 min; rated 2.67/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer claims the noise reduction job is the worst they have ever heard [20]
- **gd1985-11-01.168186.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd85-11-01.oade.connor.9217.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 4.45/5 by 40 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it the best audience recording they have ever heard [19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the show and describes the venue sound as phat [22]
- Reviewer stood close to the taper section during the performance [23]
- Jerry sings out lyrics clearly instead of muttering during the show [25]
- Jerry delivers tear-jerking vocal performances on three specific songs [27]
- It was cold and rainy with twice as many people as tickets [28]
- Someone threw dishwashing detergent into the fountain, creating a mountain of suds [28]
- It surpasses the Dick's Picks version of this show in quality [19]
- Better soundboard sources for this show exist on cassette [20]
- Reviewer liked the second night of the tour even more [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-01.cpb.retransfer.32709.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Charles Bandrofcheck; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Can't remember shotgun mics -> Sony D6 -> Maxel MX 90s. As close as they'd let you get to the left of SBD [1]. Also: Recording used two cassettes with no flips during the actual performance [1]
- **gd1985-11-01.177938.Senn.MD421.strizak.flac2448**: taped by Tom Strizak; transferred by Tom Strizak; source: Tom Strizak Master Cassettes (2) Senn. MD421 stereo configuration (mic stand at approx. 7’) > Sony TC-D5M (2 Fugi -FR90 Metal/Dolby-B). Location: Taper section… [2]. Also: Lost Sailor is cut and clips back in at approximately one minute forty-one seconds [2]
- **gd85-11-01.sbd.mccloskey.379.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard> ?> DAT> CDr [3]
- **gd1985-11-01.168186.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Charlie Miller handled the transfer and coordinated the release effort [5]
- **gd85-11-01.oade.connor.9217.sbeok.shnf**: source: Oade DFOB -- Schoeps CMC441 (spaced 17cm@90deg) + CMC42 (Spread 8')> Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1 > DAT (@44.1k) [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Poster Richmond 1985, Rare | #2017340712](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-poster-richmond-1985-2017340712) [32]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1985-11-01 Richmond Coliseum, Richmond, VA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-11-01-richmond-coliseum-richmond-va-usa/) [33]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1985-11-01 Fri Richmond Coliseum, Richmond, VA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1423910229959/grateful-dead-1985-11-01-fri-richmond) [34]
